fukushima.description: Regional dishes, noodles, fruit and seafood: a guide to the flavors of Aizu, Nakadori and Hamadori in Fukushima.
fukushima.subtitle: Stories about the tastes of Fukushima
fukushima.about: A Fukushima food guide based on social posts by people who visited local eateries. Cover images are AI-created watercolor illustrations; see the embedded original posts for actual photos of the food.

fukushima:echigoya-omose-fukushima.title: Fukushima City "Echigoya Omose" — Hearty Nori Bento Set Meal
fukushima:echigoya-omose-fukushima.summary: "Echigoya Omose," a set-meal restaurant in Fukushima City. Its lavish nori bento is highly acclaimed, with visitors' posts noting that the portions are generous for the price.
fukushima:echigoya-omose-fukushima.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a nori-ben set meal
fukushima:echigoya-omose-fukushima.markdown:
This is "Echigoya Omose," a set-meal restaurant in Fukushima City.

The original post describes a luxurious nori bento. The visitor's impression comes across—that it was hearty and filling, and that this amount at this price is a great value.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@__yna.24/post/DBRA8HWzlNM)

fukushima:kurosawa-fukushima.title: Fukushima City "Washoku Kurosawa" — Kuroge Wagyu Hitsumabushi Gozen "Kagayaki"
fukushima:kurosawa-fukushima.summary: "Kurosawa," a Japanese restaurant in the Shinobuyama area of Fukushima City. Visitor reviews highlight its Kuroge Wagyu hitsumabushi set meal as offering great value for the price.
fukushima:kurosawa-fukushima.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a Kuroge Wagyu hitsumabushi set meal
fukushima:kurosawa-fukushima.markdown:
This is Kurosawa, a Japanese restaurant in the Shinobuyama area of Fukushima City.

The original post describes ordering the "Kagayaki" Kuroge Wagyu hitsumabushi set meal. Praised as "affordable and delicious," it seems to have left a lasting impression as a meal where one can enjoy high-quality Wagyu in the form of hitsumabushi.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@shijing957/post/Deve8Q6oArY)

fukushima:kuwon-fukushima.title: Fukushima City "Handmade Jumbo Gyoza Shop Kuwon" — Large Gyoza Set Meal
fukushima:kuwon-fukushima.summary: "Tezukuri Jumbo Gyoza no Mise Kuwon," located near the west exit of Fukushima Station. Its set meals featuring gyoza and niku-sui—both far larger than usual—have earned rave reviews in posts from multiple visitors.
fukushima:kuwon-fukushima.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a jumbo gyoza set meal
fukushima:kuwon-fukushima.markdown:
This is "Tezukuri Jumbo Gyoza no Mise Kuwon," located right by the west exit of Fukushima Station.

The original post describes how surprised the writer was by the jumbo gyoza, each of which was enormous. The visitor mentioned that they regretted ordering the 6-piece set because it was too large, suggesting that a 4-piece set would be just right. Another visitor's post also noted that the combination of gyoza and niku-sui (meat soup) was delicious.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@takita0411/post/Dd0_JcKgdev)

fukushima:narikoma-nihonmatsu.title: Nihonmatsu City "Oshokujidokoro Narikoma" — Sauce Katsudon
fukushima:narikoma-nihonmatsu.summary: "Oshokujidokoro Narikoma" in Nihonmatsu City. A katsudon served with sauce rather than egg-simmered is described as "delicious" in visitor reviews.
fukushima:narikoma-nihonmatsu.markdown:
This is "Oshokujidokoro Narikoma" in Nihonmatsu City.

The original post describes a meal of sauce katsudon. A visitor who prefers sauce katsudon over egg-simmered katsudon looked thoroughly satisfied with their bowl.

You can find the restaurant's location, phone number, and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@chloehina1031/post/DY88vHZkQ7m)
